entry.title: New: dsh-oauth-mcp-client
entry.summary: OAuth 2.1 MCP client for Streamable HTTP servers: add a connection in Settings, sign in through the browser (PKCE with dynamic client registration), and have its tools registered in DSH, with tokens kept in the credential service and the connection written to the profile. Exact install spec: github:springbrand-lab/dsh-oauth-mcp-client. Source event: awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin; changed: listed.
